methodology: The original research topic and the generated technical specification were decomposed into atomic units by identifying individual requirements, features, behaviors, and constraints. Each atomic unit is designed to be independent, self-contained, technically specific, unambiguous, and implementable as a single requirement. The goal was to create sets of atomic information that could be compared to assess the coverage and similarity between the original topic and the generated specification.
mindtraced_atomic_units: FSM detects sequence 1101 in serial input bit stream (data).
When sequence 1101 is detected, start_shifting is set to 1.
start_shifting remains high until reset is asserted.
When reset is asserted on rising clock edge, start_shifting is set to 0.
If sequence 1101 is detected multiple times before reset, start_shifting remains high.
spec_atomic_units: start_shifting output is 0 when reset is 1.
When reset is 0, start_shifting output becomes 1 and remains 1 forever after sequence detection.
Combinational logic detects the '1101' sequence in the input data stream.
Once the sequence is detected, the start_shifting output is set to 1 and remains 1 regardless of the input data stream until reset.
start_shifting output changes only on the rising edge of clk.
When reset is high on a rising edge of clk, start_shifting is immediately set to 0.
When the sequence '1101' is detected in data, start_shifting is set to 1 on the rising edge of clk and remains 1 until reset is asserted.
The value of data must be stable a setup time before the rising edge of clk and held stable a hold time after the rising edge of clk.
The reset signal must also meet setup and hold time requirements with respect to the rising edge of clk.
The start_shifting output changes after a clock-to-output delay from the rising edge of clk.
